interface.shortDescription: Read-only PhageScope phage database: 2.58M phages, 131M proteins, 12.6M protein families.
interface.longDescription: Query the PhageScope phage genome database from your agent: search and aggregate phages by host, lifestyle, completeness and taxonomy, read phage details and genome sequences, search proteins and protein families, query annotated features and resolve predicted structures. Eleven read-only tools; every result carries provenance (source, data snapshot, retrieval time), paging and truncation limits, and keeps unknown values distinct from zero. Sign up at https://phageagent.deepomics.org and create your own read-only token.
